authorityBoundary.observerScope: This family classifies status, checks, alerting, logs, risk-event views and backup/runbook evidence only. It contains operational telemetry/alert-state writers, not money settlement writers.
authorityBoundary.controlExclusion: Dispute opening, payout freeze/execution/reconciliation, provider record_outcome/cooldown/probation/reset and autodeploy remain attributed to their payment, payout or deployment families; effectWriterExcluded means excluded from this acceptance/authority, not absent from deployed processes.
authorityBoundary.moneyAuthority: Pure monitoring is not a money writer. Provider health is money-adjacent because routing consumes it; stale or false health must not silently authorize unsafe routing.
authorityBoundary.custody: Monitoring needs no signing key or provider mutation credential. The effective root unit and shared app/runtime environment exceed that intended boundary; deployed bot balance_monitor reads USDT_PRIVATE_KEY and constructs a PrivateKey if configured, although credential presence/value was not inspected.

positiveControls: The enabled active standalone daemon checks pending-order age, provider score health, recent conversion and payout-queue age on a configurable interval and attempts Telegram operator alerts.
Relay persists provider health plus alert throttle/high-water state; Laravel exposes risk events read-only.
The public aggregate status hides provider names and Mini App checks HTTP success before rendering it.

A PostgreSQL cutover runbook and scratch restore-smoke tool exist. Enabled KAIROS shadow backup/verify timers and a path unit protect only the E2 shadow journal; they are narrow same-host controls, not Obsidian PostgreSQL/customer-money backup acceptance.

criticalFindings.finding: Each standalone check catches query/import errors and returns no issue; run_checks then logs All checks passed. Loss of observer visibility is therefore represented as health rather than UNKNOWN/BROKEN.

No deployed/source evidence was observed in the inspected Exchange units and entrypoints for an independent dead-man, fresh cycle record, sd_notify/Systemd WatchdogSec, missed-cycle metric or secondary-host probe.

Alerts are direct single-channel Telegram POSTs without durable intent, stable incident/message identity, retry/backoff, ambiguous-send quarantine, acknowledgement, escalation, resolution or secondary channel.

One locally healthy provider makes the entire public status operational. No check freshness/as-of or dependency coverage is exposed, while DB reporting failure can make the route fail; Mini App translates operational into all systems work and payments are accepted.

Embedded alert throttle/high-water state can advance before or independently of proven Telegram delivery. Conversely standalone persistent incidents repeat every cycle. No canonical incident lifecycle reconciles these semantics.

Standalone, Relay and bot monitors overlap with different thresholds/state and omit an accepted registry covering canonical payout intents, notification outboxes, DB saturation, chain RPC, reserves, artifact drift, backup restore freshness and every deployed service.
The active monitor runs as root without service sandbox hardening and consumes shared app/runtime environment bundles, despite requiring only read-only DB access and Telegram alert capability.
Hard-coded thresholds have no versioned SLI/SLO, error budget, severity/owner/on-call, acknowledgement deadline, maintenance policy, incident ID, rehearsed runbook or postmortem linkage.

Restore-smoke/runbook presence and bot file-age checks do not prove scheduled encrypted off-host PostgreSQL backups, immutable retention, RPO/RTO, recurring restore verification or alerting on timer/result failure. Installed KAIROS shadow backup/verify units cover a narrow same-host E2 journal only, not PostgreSQL, receipts or wallets.
The enabled root autodeploy timer is deployment/control authority and is explicitly excluded from monitoring evidence; timer presence cannot be credited as observability or safe remediation.

Operator alerts and risk views contain order, amount, provider and customer/device metadata. No allowlisted telemetry schema, redaction guarantee, least-privilege viewer contract, retention/deletion/backup-expiry or access audit is proven.

Relay audit writes raw registration/login email and whole provider webhook dictionaries via str(data) directly to the operations store with 90-day cleanup. Logging filters do not protect this persistence path, so uncontrolled PII/payment/secret-bearing fields may be retained.
The bot SSL check searches openssl s_client stderr for notAfter but does not alert on nonzero return or missing match; parse/probe failure can silently look healthy.

Several tasks called watch/monitor perform disputes, transitions, routing cooldowns or remediation. These effect writers require separately authorized immutable intents and cannot inherit acceptance from observational monitoring.

telegramBot.reason: Primary alert/status destination and operator control surface; delivery, acknowledgement, escalation and incident recovery are unaccepted.

site.reason: Public aggregate status exists but has unsafe component coverage, freshness and operational semantics.

miniApp.reason: Polls aggregate status and overstates one-route health as all systems/payment readiness.

admin.reason: Analytics and read-only risk/event resources exist without a unified incident inbox, ownership, acknowledgement, SLO or runbook workflow.

api.reason: Public status and internal read models exist without versioned liveness/readiness/metrics/check/incident contracts.

native.reason: No deployed native status projection exists; future native must not gain remediation or money authority.

limitations: No authenticated/customer-row query, external probe, Telegram send, secret value, writer, deploy or restart was exercised.
Active/enabled metadata and source presence do not prove fresh successful cycles, alert delivery, incident response, backup restorability or SLO attainment.
nextCanonicalItem: Classify AI_ASSISTANT across all six surfaces without granting autonomous money, signing, custody or hidden control authority.
